name: SimpleReceiver

expect.contains: Ready to receive IR signals of protocols: NEC/NEC2/Onkyo/Apple
Protocol=NEC Address=0x0, Command=0x45, Raw-Data=0xBA45FF00, 32 bits, LSB first
Protocol=NEC Address=0x0, Command=0x15, Raw-Data=0xEA15FF00, 32 bits, LSB first

Repeat received. Here you can repeat the same action as before.
Protocol=NEC Address=0x0, Command=0x15, Repeat

assertions.doc: VOL+'s second repeat follows its first one's message

description: IRremote's SimpleReceiver, unmodified, on D2 with the kit remote: CH- held 120 ms (its frame and one repeat code 108 ms after it) and VOL+ held 300 ms (two repeats). The library's Timer2 sampling at 50 us decodes each NEC frame (address 0x00, command and complement: raw 0xBA45FF00 and 0xEA15FF00, as worked out from the protocol beforehand) and flags the repeats; its printed gaps and durations are its own 50 us tick counts of the receiver's output.
